document.description: The raw value of the document, as indexed.

title.description: The primary name of the document (e.g. name, title, identifier, etc).

text.description: Free-form text of the document (e.g. description, content, etc).

location.description: The relative or absolute URL of the document (target when a search result is clicked).

highlight.description:
Optional result highlight. Useful for improving the search result
display/experience.

rank.description:
Optional result rank, where 1 is the first/top result returned. 
Useful for understanding search effectiveness in analytics.

default.description: An error response from the backend.
